channel.title: Treasure Coast Today
channel.description: Local news for Martin, St. Lucie and Indian River counties, Florida.

item.title: Martin County faces $2.1 billion transportation funding gap as needs outpace available money
item.description: Martin County is facing a $2.1 billion transportation funding shortfall, and the gap between what the county needs and what it can afford could shape how residents get around for decades.

item.title: Five cyclospora cases confirmed across Treasure Coast counties since May
item.description: Health officials report cyclospora infections in St. Lucie, Martin and Palm Beach counties as contaminated lettuce outbreaks spread nationwide.

item.title: Florida voter registration data downloaded by Chinese cyber actor in 2022, declassified records show
item.description: Newly released intelligence records show Florida was among six states whose publicly available voter information was downloaded from commercial websites.

item.title: Democratic state Rep. Angie Nixon gets September trial date for Capitol sit-in charges
item.description: The Jacksonville legislator will stand trial the week of Sept. 21 on misdemeanor charges from her May protest outside Gov. Ron DeSantis' office.

item.title: Boynton Beach firefighters rescue dog from raw sewage lift station
item.description: Firefighter Ramirez rescued the dog and safely exited the lift station in just 4 minutes after it fell 10 to 12 feet into raw sewage.

item.title: Boca Raton man arrested for soliciting videos from minor, Boynton Beach police say more victims possible
item.description: Maximiliano Buitrago, 51, was arrested after allegedly responding to a Craigslist babysitting post and asking a 14-year-old for videos.

item.title: West Palm Beach VA Healthcare System hosts resource fair in Loxahatchee for veterans
item.description: VA representatives assisted veterans with eligibility, enrollment and claims support at Big Dog Ranch Rescue on Friday.

item.title: Boynton Beach police arrest Boca Raton man for soliciting videos from 14-year-old
item.description: Maximiliano Buitrago, 51, of Boca Raton was arrested after responding to an undercover Craigslist post offering babysitting services and asking a supposed 14-year-old for videos in exchange for money.

item.title: JetBlue ending Vero Beach to JFK route in September due to low demand
item.description: JetBlue is canceling its flight route between Vero Beach Regional Airport and New York's JFK Airport, with the last flights operating on Sept. 9. item.title: Murray Middle School demolition underway in Martin County after Hurricane Milton tornado damage
item.description: Murray Middle School demolition is underway in Martin County, marking the start of a major reconstruction effort following tornado damage caused by Hurricane Milton.

item.title: Humane Society of the Treasure Coast seeks fosters and adopters during shelter renovation
item.description: The Humane Society of the Treasure Coast is calling on the community to foster or adopt animals as the organization enters phase two of a major facility renovation.

item.title: Treasure Coast residents avoid lettuce after E. coli and cyclospora outbreaks
item.description: As reports of contaminated produce continue to spread across the country, many people in South Florida are changing what they eat and what they avoid.

item.title: MLB restricts dugout iPad use to prevent artificial intelligence from making game decisions
item.description: Major League Baseball made custom tabs on dugout iPads inaccessible starting Wednesday night to prevent teams from using AI for substitutions and pitch calling.

item.title: Argentina beats England 2-1 in World Cup semifinal with late goals from Fernandez and Martinez
item.description: Argentina rallied from a 1-0 deficit in the final minutes to defeat England 2-1 on Wednesday and advance to the World Cup final.

item.title: Photographer who captured Messi bathing infant Yamal reflects on images ahead of World Cup final
item.description: Photos taken in 2007 of Lionel Messi bathing baby Lamine Yamal have gone viral before Sunday's World Cup final between Argentina and Spain.

item.title: FBI seizes hundreds of drones near stadiums during World Cup as final security tightens
item.description: Federal agents, local law enforcement, and private companies have spent two years preparing security for Sunday's World Cup final in New Jersey.

item.title: Spain faces Argentina in World Cup final Sunday as Yamal, 19, meets Messi, 39
item.description: The 2026 FIFA World Cup comes down to one final match Sunday in New Jersey between Argentina and Spain.

item.title: Flip City gymnasts from Treasure Coast finish top 15 at nationals, qualify for Junior Olympics
item.description: Three gymnasts from Flip City Gym and Cheer qualified for the Junior Olympics after securing a top 15 finish at AAU Nationals in Knoxville, Tennessee last month. item.description:
The St. Lucie Mets opened the second half of the season with a 3-2 extra-inning win over the Palm Beach Cardinals on Friday night at Roger Dean Chevrolet Stadium.

item.title: Florida state Rep. Fabian Basabe ordered to pay $450,000 in sexual harassment, battery case
item.description: A Leon County jury ordered Republican state Rep. Fabian Basabe to pay $450,000 after finding him liable for sexual harassment, battery and defamation. The civil judgment came at the end of a trial brought by former legislative aide Nicolas Frevola, former intern Jacob Cutbirth and Frevola's mother.

item.title: Democratic state Rep. Angie Nixon faces September trial on charges from Capitol sit-in
item.description: Democratic state Rep. Angie Nixon will stand trial the week of Sept. 21 on misdemeanor charges stemming from her May sit-in outside Gov. Ron DeSantis' Capitol office.

item.title: Alex Vindman raises $8.5 million in Florida Senate race, expands fundraising lead over Nixon
item.description: Retired Army Lt. Alex Vindman tightened his grip on the Democratic money lead during the second quarter, raising $8.5 million and pushing his total receipts above $16 million.

item.title: Defense Secretary Hegseth backs Blue Angels' low Pensacola beach flyover despite safety concerns
item.description: Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth is sticking to encouraging low-altitude military flyovers after a Blue Angels jet buzzed a Pensacola beach so low that chairs and tents went flying and sand kicked up.

item.title: South Florida residents avoid lettuce, berries amid E. coli and cyclospora outbreaks
item.description: Reports of contaminated produce continue to spread across the country, and many people in South Florida are changing what they eat and what they avoid.

item.title: Declassified records show Chinese cyber actor downloaded Florida voter registration data in 2022
item.description: Declassified records released by the White House say a Chinese cyber actor downloaded publicly available Florida voter-registration information from commercial websites in 2022.

item.title: Republican gubernatorial candidate James Fishback faces eligibility challenge in Florida court
item.description: Republican gubernatorial candidate James Fishback will defend his eligibility to remain in the primary in court next week.

item.title: Fort Pierce woman wins $5 million from $20 scratch-off ticket
item.description:
